artifactId.description: The derived combined-text artifact — since commit 1111d39 (17.9.2026) this is the e-mail body PLUS every successfully-extracted attachment's text, combined ('=== TĚLO E-MAILU ===' then '=== PŘÍLOHA: ... ===' per attachment), not the body alone. What document.classify/validate/stamp actually read, same as any other channel.

originalArtifactId.description: The immutable raw MIME message, unchanged — evidence/audit and GET /workflow/:id/attachment/:n, never a capability's input.

attachmentArtifactIds.description: DERIVED/compatibility view over `attachments`: artifactId of every attachment with status SUCCEEDED, in original attachment order. Kept for callers that read only this field — for the non-silent per-attachment outcome (including WHY a failed one is absent here) read `attachments`.

attachments.description: One entry per parsed e-mail attachment, in original order — nothing is ever silently dropped here, unlike attachmentArtifactIds (best-effort per attachment still applies: one FAILED attachment never fails the whole message).

errorCode.description: Present iff status is FAILED. EXTRACTION_UNAVAILABLE/EXTRACTION_FAILED/EXTRACTION_EMPTY are adapters/extract.ts's own ExtractResult codes (ok:false); STORAGE_FULL is a caught StorageFull from deps.artifacts.derive(); UNEXPECTED_ERROR is any other caught throw.

subject.description: Data, never interpreted. Truncated to 200 characters.
